description: Official US gas prices as JSON, no API key: weekly retail regular, midgrade, premium gasoline and diesel prices (USD/gallon) for the US, 10 PADD regions, 9 states and 10 cities from the EIA survey, with week-over-week and year-over-year change, 52-week high/low, history since 1990 (weekly, monthly or yearly averages) and a trip fuel cost calculator. Monitor mode returns only new weeks. Usable from AI agents via MCP. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.02/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/us-gas-prices-api.

areas.description: US, PADD1..PADD5 (East Coast, Midwest, Gulf Coast, Rocky Mountain, West Coast), PADD1A/1B/1C, PADD5XCA, states CA CO FL MA MN NY OH TX WA, cities BOS CHI CLE DEN HOU LAX MIA NYC SFO SEA, or names like 'California' / 'New York City'. 'all' =

distanceKm.description: trip mode: trip distance in kilometers (used when distanceMiles is empty).

distanceMiles.description: trip mode: trip distance in miles (or use distanceKm).

endDate.description: history mode: last week, YYYY-MM-DD. Default latest.

fuels.description: regular, midgrade, premium, allGrades, diesel ('all' = every fuel). Empty = regular + diesel for latest, regular for history and trip. Diesel is published for US, PADD regions, CA and PADD5XCA.

interval.description: history mode: weekly survey values, or monthly / yearly averages of the weekly values.

litersPer100km.description: trip mode: fuel economy in L/100 km (used when mpg is empty).

mode.description: latest = newest weekly price per area and fuel with weekly/yearly change and 52-week high/low; history = price series between startDate and endDate (weekly, or monthly/yearly averages); trip = fuel cost of a trip from distance and fuel econ

mpg.description: trip mode: vehicle fuel economy in US mpg. Default 25 when litersPer100km is also empty.

sort.description: latest mode: area order (default), cheapest first, most expensive first, or biggest weekly rise first.

startDate.description: history mode: first week, YYYY-MM-DD (or YYYY / YYYY-MM). Default one year ago. Gasoline from 1990/1994, diesel from 1994.

name: us_gas_prices_api
title: Gas Prices API - US Gasoline & Diesel by State, Weekly History
